eps.o: As news spreads of Karen's car accident and DUI charge, the ladies rally around her, but not without asking a few probing questions. Wendy closes an important chapter in her life. Ashley meets with a lawyer to finally take the next steps toward divorce. Mia navigates co-parenting with Gordon, but her unique family dynamic leads to a big conflict.

The fallout from Karen's "hattitude" birthday continues as a few of the ladies try to reel in the drama. Gizelle and Wendy meet to hash out their issues, Keiarna checks-in on Karen and Stacey opens up to Ashley. Gizelle and Ashley's GnA event is challenged by the Grande Dame, who forces the ladies to make a difficult choice.

Shocked by the dramatic GnA ousting, the group seeks answers and apologies. Keiarna settles in at her boyfriend's house. Mia and Inc have a staycation to get some space of their own. Stacey's close friend TJ comes to town. Gizelle attempts to make amends with the ladies before an upcoming trip, with surprising results.

The ladies arrive in Lake Norman, N.C., to turn up, but some aren't ready for the heat that's unleashed. Jacqueline's relationship with Mia is questioned. Stacey and Keiarna both have bones to pick with Ashley. Mia reveals a long-held alleged secret about Karen, leaving everyone shocked.

Mia reveals what she allegedly overheard on the phone with Karen years ago, leaving the table speechless. The ladies ring in Wendy's 40th birthday. Gizelle heads back to Maryland to attend Angel and Adore's cap-and-gown ceremony. Chaos erupts over breakfast when Mia and Ashley's friendship takes an unusual turn.

The group is shook as they navigate the fallout from the messy breakfast. Gizelle returns to Lake Norman. Mia takes the ladies on a detour to unwind before trying to work things out with Keiarna. At a celebratory dinner for Wendy's 40th, Jassi opens up to the women about her relationship, but some details aren't adding up.

The clock is ticking on Karen's court date as she examines what really caused her accident. Jassi hosts an event for her boyfriend, Darius, after a meeting at the White House. It's a cavalcade of partners as some of the ladies' men are introduced to the group for the first time. Wendy preps for her 40th birthday bash and tries to bring her extended family together. Karen's big day in court arrives. Ashley performs her new single at a GnA event. Mia confides to the ladies about rising tensions between Gordon and Inc. Gizelle and Mia's confrontation causes issues within the group.

Ashley and Stacey each attend their divorce mediation appointments with unforeseen outcomes. Keiarna and Greg examine their relationship more closely. Gizelle spends time with Grace as she anticipates becoming an empty nester. Mia is pushed to her breaking point when her life choices are questioned.

Gizelle joins Ashley to play the field and find new love. Karen and Ray address the work needed to repair their institution. TJ confronts Stacey about the state of their relationship. Wendy braces for a tough conversation with her mother. Mia and Gordon discuss their decision to divorce and the conversation takes a surprising turn.

Stacey gets some heat for her relationship with TJ. Wendy makes a grand invitation to continue her 40th festivities in Panama. Karen hosts a "Love Lagoon" party at her home – full of risqué questions, unexpected answers and one uninvited guest with eight uninvited balloons.

Jacqueline's peace offering at Karen's Love Lagoon falls flat. The ladies head to Panama where Wendy sets up some choice room pairings. During a dinner, the group has words with Mia about her behavior.

Wendy takes the group to Panama City for some fun with rum. Stacey continues to try and win over her roommate, Gizelle. As the nightly festivities continue, a few of the ladies unload on Mia about unresolved issues.

Stacey comes to grips with her divorce. The ladies take a yacht cruise, and Keiarna opens up about a recent botched trip with Greg. A seductive moment between two of the women stirs feelings of jealousy within the group.

The ladies return from their Panama trip. Ashley prepares for her Drag King event. Stacey works to finalize her divorce while fielding requests from TJ. Gordon reveals some shocking information to Ray, which Karen levies against Mia to figure out the truth.

eps.o: Keiarna and Greg work through their issues together. Inc expresses his frustrations to Mia. Karen decides to bow out of Stacey's event after feeling betrayed. Stacey responds accordingly.

Gizelle honors her father, Ashley gives a major life update and Dr. Wendy goes to the White House. Karen's latest court date looms as she questions her friendships. Stacey's charity event unravels in an unexpected fashion.

The season nine reunion begins with a surprise as the ladies learn that the Grande Dame will not be in attendance, but not completely absent either. Wendy expresses her disappointment with Karen's lack of accountability this season. Ashley, Mia and Stacey reveal the statuses of their divorces. Jassi and Stacey confront Mia about her shocking behavior during her off-camera birthday in Miami.

The reunion continues with Mia spiraling backstage after her confrontation. Keiarna and Stacey face tough criticism about their relationships with Greg and TJ, but when new revelations are made, the women are left speechless. When the ladies take her to task for her actions throughout the season, Mia finally reaches her breaking point.

A shocking exit threatens to disrupt the reunion, but the drama continues. The nature of Stacey's relationship with TJ is called into question when one of the husbands drops a huge bombshell. The group takes a deep dive into Karen's DUI and long-held secrets finally come to light. Never-before-seen footage of Karen and Ray leaves a few of the ladies stunned.
